name: Al-Akhtal
bio: Al-Akhtal was a Christian poet of Taghlib who grew up near al-Hira in Iraq and divided his time between his people in Upper Mesopotamia and the Umayyad court at Damascus. He praised the caliphs and took part in the verse contests associated with Jarir and al-Farazdaq, in which a reply took up its opponent's metre and rhyme. Al-Zirikli says he discarded much of a poem before letting it circulate and dates his death to 90 AH (708 CE).
